mapper.select: SELECT r.name AS name, COUNT(u.id) AS value FROM identity r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON r.id = u.type GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY r.id

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY AS name UNION ALL SELECT name + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM date_range WHERE name < CURDATE() ) SELECT dr.name, COUNT(l.who) AS value FROM date_range dr LEFT JOIN log l ON DATE(l.login) = dr.name GROUP BY dr.name ORDER BY dr.name;
